definitions.explanation: The act of combining two or more substances or elements together.

examples.japanese: {色|いろ}の{混合|こんごう}で{新|あたら}しい{色|いろ}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: I create new colors by mixing colors.

examples.japanese: {混合|こんごう}{チーム|ちーむ}で{試合|しあい}をした。
examples.english: We played a game with a mixed team.

examples.japanese: {薬品|やくひん}を{混合|こんごう}する{際|さい}は{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Caution is necessary when mixing chemicals.

notes:
{混合|こんごう} means mixing or combining two or more things together.

GRAMMAR:
Can function as a noun or する verb ({混合|こんごう}する = to mix).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {混合|こんごう}{物|ぶつ}: mixture, blend
- {混合|こんごう}{気|き}{体|たい}: mixed gas
- {混合|こんごう}チーム: mixed team
- {混合|こんごう}ワクチン: combined vaccine
- {混合|こんごう}{栄養|えいよう}: mixed feeding (breast milk and formula)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {混合|こんごう}: mixing (technical, combining substances)
- {混|ま}ぜる: to mix (everyday verb)
- {配合|はいごう}: blending, compounding (in formulas)
- {融合|ゆうごう}: fusion, merging (becoming one)
